snippet.title: Forest Escape: Last Train - Gameplay Trailer - FGS Live From GDC 2026
snippet.description:
Forest Escape: Last Train Join The Playtest Trailer. Forest Escape: Last Train is a Co-op horror game in which you must gather resources, repair your train and make it through a terrifying world. Forest Escape: Last Train has a playtest running now on PC.

Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4090360/Forest_Escape_Last_Train/

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS
